d: A mature, athletic build fully encased in heavy, interlocking plate armor of a dark charcoal and obsidian palette. The head is covered by a menacing, dark metallic helmet featuring thick, curved horns that sweep backward and glowing crimson eyes peering through a narrow slit. A dark navy-blue fabric cloak is draped over the shoulders, contrasting with the matte and polished surfaces of the black metal plating.
